scoring: Ten equally weighted checks; every critical check must pass. Isolated worker success does not establish production integration.
scope: Explicit optional reviewed redirects, supervised library pagination and hash-bound PDF programme review inside the private event collection service.

checks.required: Absent optional configuration preserves existing collection behavior. Missing, expired, malformed or unsafe configuration disables only the affected adapter and raises an actionable alert; unaffected sources continue.
Exact registered source identity, HTTPS origin/path/port, public DNS and actual browser destination binding. No credentials, private-network access, generic redirects or unrelated POST actions.

Immutable dependency versions; non-root read-only runtime; bounded bytes/pages/time/memory; fresh per-run identity. Actual hung browser termination proves process ownership and no surviving owned browser group. Failed launch cannot reuse old success.

Actual retained source bytes, hashes, capture times and source identity bind every page/URL/PDF claim. Changed PDF hashes invalidate prior manual census; ambiguous times, status and repeated timetable rows remain explicit review-only uncertainty.

Complete captures merge through existing staging and compare-before-write safeguards. Preserve previous leads, original identities, source history, all human review/approval fields and pending edits. Partial or failed worker results cannot replace complete prior state.
Observe actual integrated collection receipts from the exact installed image and durable mount. Show due fetch, not-due/cache distinctions and bounded retry. Configuration is not proof of refresh.

Actual integrated failure creates a deduplicated actionable dashboard episode; unaffected collection continues. A later actual successful capture resolves that episode. Dashboard delivery, Codex delivery and human acknowledgement remain separate.
Private captures/config/packets do not enter public artifacts. No new approval, public listing, status/price/media claim or credentials can be created by source collection.

Preserve the prior image/container and durable before-state. Disable optional configuration or restore prior image without overwriting later human edits. Dashboard shows source-specific outcomes and review links clearly.

Independent rubric review of source, meaningful regression tests, exact-image observation, preserved-state evidence and final deployed runtime cycle. Require at least9/10 and all critical checks before accepting this stage.

limitations: Acceptance does not establish comprehensive Shire coverage or approve any listing. Those require their own evidence and James's current approval.
